subject: Request: credit/discount while private deployment feature delayed
messages:
From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for interim credits while private deployment delayed

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re excited about moving forward but Procurement ran into a blocker: the private VPC deployment option we scoped (required for our compliance) won’t be available for the GA we expected in mid-February. Our security team is flagging the gap and they’ve asked for a commercial concession (either a one-time credit or a time-bound discount) until the private deployment is in place.

Quick context: PO is signed but on hold pending this resolution. The deal is $480k ARR across 2 years. Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a credit for the period where they’ll be on hosted instead of private (approx 3 months).

Can you confirm if Redwood can offer a credit or discount and what the approval path looks like? They need a written concession to move the PO through procurement this week.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Sarah

--
Sarah Bennett
Head of IT Procurement
Acme Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@acmehealth.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for interim credits while private deployment delayed

Hi Sarah — thanks for flagging and for the clear context. I’m sorry the private deployment timing is causing a pause. I’ve looped in product and finance to evaluate an exception.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- I’ll surface a recommended concession (credit or temporary discount) and the approval route (we may need one-off exec sign-off).
- Rishi will confirm commercial impact and suggested structure to keep this to a one-time credit vs changing list pricing.
- Vivek and Priyom will confirm earliest reliable ETA for the private deployment and any mitigations (e.g., restricted data zones / stronger controls on hosted).

Can you confirm the absolute PO deadline (procurement needs the written concession by EOD Friday 2/6 to keep their timeline)?

Will get back shortly — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
m: 415-555-0132
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Acme - credit request due to private deploy gap (need exec exception)

Team — forwarding Acme’s ask. TL;DR: $480k ARR deal is on hold unless we provide a written concession covering ~3 months while they remain on hosted (security requested). Procurement needs this by EOD 2/6.

Details / asks:
- Recommended concession: 3 months pro-rated credit on hosted invoice (~25% of expected invoice for those months), OR a 15% time-bound discount for the first quarter of the contract. I’m leaning to a one-time credit to avoid permanent list price changes.
- Commercial impact: Rishi, please quantify cost to Redwood and confirm whether this sets a bad precedent.
- Product: Vivek / Priyom, what is the earliest we can promise private deployment for this account? If ETA is <45 days and we can provide additional controls in the interim, we could offer a smaller credit.
- Legal/Finance: Lauren — would we need exec sign-off for this structural exception? If so, please route (CEO/Head of Revenue or CFO) — I can supply a short note for approval.

Attachments: Acme_SOW_review.pdf (procurement’s SOW and ask). I also attached my notes on roadmap timing (Roadmap_Q2_ETA_notes.md).

Need a decision by EOD 2/5 to give me time to send a written concession to Acme for their procurement cutoff. Happy to sync 30m if helpful.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme - credit request due to private deploy gap (need exec exception)

Marissa / team — quick product input.
- ETA: Current private deployment (VPC/on-prem orchestration) GA is targeted for 2026-03-20 for the initial regional rollout. For this customer’s specific compliance needs we can realistically commit to a customer-specific private deployment by 2026-03-15 if we prioritize their account and allocate staging capacity. That’s ~40 days from now.
- Mitigations: We can offer a temporary controls package for hosted that includes: dedicated network egress rules, heightened logging retention for 90 days, and an access-control review. These are operational (no code) and can be stood up within 5 business days.
- Recommendation: given ETA ~40 days, offer a capped one-time credit covering the difference between hosted and committed private pricing for up to 45 days. Also include the temporary controls in writing. That reduces financial exposure and keeps the sales motion moving.

If we agree, I’ll produce a short technical attestation letter we can attach to the concession.

— Vivek
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 08:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme - credit request due to private deploy gap (need exec exception)

Marissa — reviewed. From a legal/finance perspective we’re comfortable with a one-time, capped credit (not a list-price change) tied to the limited period between now and confirmed private deployment. Conditions we need in the concession memo:
1) Credit amount capped to X% or $Y (recommend cap = lesser of 15% of first-year ARR or three months of hosted differential; Rishi to supply exact $).
2) Credit applied as pro-rated invoice credit; not a percentage reduction to list price.
3) Delivery commitment: Redwood must provide a delivery ETA (we’ll use the product ETA of 2026-03-15) and provide the technical attestation (Vivek).
4) Termination clause: if RDC (Acme) cancels before deployment, credit remains valid for that billing period only.
5) Exec approval: CFO and Head of Revenue sign-off required for any credit > $50k.

I’m happy to route for approval. Rishi — please confirm the recommended numeric cap and we’ll get CFO/RR sign-off today so you can send the concession letter to Acme.

— Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Legal & Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@acmehealth.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Concession: one-time, capped credit and interim controls (Acme Health)

Hi Sarah — thanks for your patience. Following internal review we can provide the following written concession to move the PO forward: 

1) Concession: one-time invoice credit capped at the lesser of 15% of first-year ARR or three months of hosted-vs-private differential. For Acme this equates to a $40,000 one-time credit (Rishi confirmed).
2) Duration: credit applies to invoices for the period while Acme remains on hosted, up to a maximum of 45 days.
3) Delivery commitment: Redwood commits to delivering a private deployment for Acme no later than 2026-03-15. Vivek will provide a technical attestation within 24 hours.
4) Controls: Redwood will enable enhanced logging retention and network egress restrictions within 5 business days.
5) Terms: credit applied as a pro-rated invoice adjustment; credit does not modify list pricing.

This concession requires CFO/Head of Revenue approval as noted; approvals are in place and I’m authorized to confirm the $40k credit to Acme. If acceptable, please confirm and we’ll issue a short concession memo for Procurement to attach to the PO.

Next steps: confirm by end of day 2/6 — I’ll send the formal concession memo and Vivek’s attestation once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
